title: Folate Metabolism in Colorectal Cancer Reveals Links Between Clinical and Immune Traits, Identifying CYP26A1 as a Target
summary: A folate-metabolism gene score stratifies colorectal-cancer prognosis/immune traits, and CYP26A1 is tested as a candidate target. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
ai_technology: TCGA and external clinical cohorts validate the risk score; in-vitro experiments test CYP26A1 effects on cancer-cell proliferation, migration and invasion.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.unknown: Cell evidence and retrospective cohorts do not establish clinical treatment efficacy.
